newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends up slightly vs dlr at 1,074.70.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends up slightly vs dlr at 1,074.70.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended slightly higher against the dollar at 1,074.70 in uneventful trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

They said the peso edged up 45 centavos from Tuesday's close in a move that was at least partly due to dollar sales by banks reshuffling their foreign exchange positions. There were no major players in the market, however, and trade was quiet.

Dealers reported 388 trades for a total of $176 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,072.30 before heading lower into the close. (( -- Juan Guillermo Londono, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
